thread:
alina: Fresh SSO invite, trying the Console quickstart. Paste my key (from API keys page), hit 'Send test request' and the widget spins on 'Initializing...' forever. No error shown. Anyone seen with SSO-invited accounts?

infra-bot: infra-check: quickstart container up. Sample received connection but client aborted requests after 60s timeouts. No 5xx in service logs.

derek: Can you run curl from your laptop and paste response body+status? Also which key type did you use (user token vs service key)?

alina: I used my user token obtained via SSO on the API keys page. curl I ran: `curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_user_zzz" -d '{"input":"hello"}'`
-- Response: HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
Body: `{"error":"payment_required","message":"Workspace ws_alina requires billing activation"}`
Browser console: `TypeError: Failed to fetch` then the Console quickstart UI keeps retrying.

marta: Interesting — our REST errors sometimes use `billing_required` and older SDKs surfaced `payment_required`. If the quickstart client is checking for `billing_required` specifically, it might not detect this and will treat it as a transient failure.

derek: That would explain the infinite spinner. Quickstart client currently retries on any 4xx/5xx by default. Two bugs: 1) inconsistent error code (`payment_required` vs `billing_required`) between services/versions; 2) client treats 4xx as transient and keeps retrying.

alina: Workaround that unblocked me: create a service key from Org -> API keys and use that in the quickstart; first call returned 200 and sample printed the response. But I don't want to ask all new users to do that.

devex-bot: note created: DEVEX-501 "quickstart: detect payment/billing required codes & stop infinite retry"

marta: Plan: (a) normalize API to always emit `billing_required` server-side; (b) patch legacy SDKs to map `payment_required` -> BillingRequiredError; (c) update quickstart client to treat 4xx as non-retriable and show a dedicated billing modal when either error code seen. Example client change: `if (!resp.ok) { const body = await resp.json().catch(()=>({})); if (resp.status >= 400 && resp.status < 500) { if (['billing_required','payment_required'].includes(body.error)) { showBillingModal(body.message || 'Activate billing to make API requests'); return; } showClientError(body.message||'Request failed'); return; } /* keep retry for 5xx/network */ }`

derek: I'll own the server-side normalization and open a tiny compatibility shim on the API gateway to rewrite `payment_required` -> `billing_required`. Marta, can you own the quickstart + SDK changes?

marta: Yep. Also filing UX-205 to ensure the Console shows an explicit 'Complete billing setup' CTA for invited or SSO-provisioned orgs when `billing_enabled: false` and the user has admin rights. The CTA should link to Org -> Billing and surface a short hint about using a service key to run quickstarts in the meantime.

alina: Confirmed service key works for now. Happy to test the quickstart once PRs land.

derek: PRs: gateway fix #5401, quickstart fix #5403, python-sdk mapping #5404. Adding a telemetry event quickstart.billing_blocked with code variant so we can measure how many hits are `payment_required` vs `billing_required`.

devex-bot: follow-ups assigned: derek, marta. Ticket DEVEX-501 and UX-205 created.

marta: Adding an e2e test that simulates a 402 with `payment_required` and asserts the modal appears and that client stops retrying. Will also add a tiny unit test in SDK to map the legacy code.

alina: Thanks all — once this is fixed the onboarding flow will be much smoother. :raised_hands:
